title: Marathon Session 1
summary: Structured Marathon workout focusing on tempo stamina, long run quality, marathon effort, fueling practice, fatigue resistance.
riskReason: Long runs capped to manageable durations improve endurance without excess fatigue; practise marathon pace and fueling. Monitor fatigue and maintain proper technique.
intensityGuide: Use relative intensities such as easy effort, threshold effort, race effort, or controlled hard based on category goals.

workoutStructure.segment: Main: 2×5K at marathon pace with 5min rest

variants: Easier: Reduce number of reps or increase rest between intervals.
Harder: Add one extra rep or slightly increase distance for main sets.
coachingNotes: Long runs capped to manageable durations improve endurance without excess fatigue; practise marathon pace and fueling.
commonMistakes: Common mistakes include running too hard on easy portions, neglecting recovery, or poor pacing.
safetyNotes: Begin with a thorough dynamic warm-up and avoid pushing through pain. Stay hydrated and stop if you feel dizzy.

sourceNote: Workout design informed by research on energy system demands, training distribution, and recovery best practices.
